books.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.description: A bored girl follows a waistcoated rabbit down a hole and lands in a world where logic is optional, queens are lethal, and a cat can vanish mid-conversation.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.author: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley
books.description: A gifted student assembles a living creature from dead matter, then abandons it. What follows is less a monster story than a study of ambition, neglect, and revenge.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: Elizabeth Bennet has opinions, a sharp tongue, and no patience for Mr. Darcy. Manners, money, and misjudgement do the rest.

books.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.description: Twelve adventures of literature's most famous consulting detective, narrated by Dr. Watson and set in the fog of Victorian London.

books.title: The Art of War
books.author: Sun Tzu
books.description: Thirteen compact chapters on conflict, deception, terrain, and leadership, still quoted wherever strategists gather.
